title: Nvidia says 'no' to rehiring Huang and WSJ reports SEC is probing the chipmaker
summary: WASHINGTON/SAN FRANCISCO, Nov 17 (Reuters) - Nvidia's leadership signaled they would brook no dissent in their plan to find a new CEO, rejecting a "Stand With Jensen" campaign from allies of departed CEO Jensen Huang, even as the Wall Street Journal reported a regulator was probing Nvidia. A growing effort to reinstate Huang had complicated the search, and Huang said on Tuesday he would be "honored" to return if the ‌board deemed it best.
